text:
maria: Quick sync 1: proposal to shrink console analytics envelope. Goal: ~30% storage reduction while keeping billing/routing and dashboard parity.

alex: Nice. Which fields are immutable for billing?

maria: Must keep route_id, tenant_id, ts, tokens_generated, model_name/variant, and minimal cost_summary {currency, unit_rate, model_bucket}. Everything else can be referenced or sampled.

simon: How do we handle profile_attrs->profile_id transition without breaking saved SQL that does profile_attrs->>'os'?

maria: Read-adapter shim in console API: default returns compact shape; if client passes ?compat=legacy or legacy flag enabled, API expands profile_id -> profile_attrs via a join/cache. We'll also publish a small query-rewrite guide.

priya: Raw prompts used by QA and evals. If removed we lose signals.

maria: Keep raw_prompt for eval=true and 0.5% random sample. Also allow route-level overrides via an ops config list.

dave: Backfill plan? Full rewrite is expensive. Suggest targeted backfill for top 5% of routes by volume. Others use read-adapter.

simon: Pseudo SQL for profiles extract:

INSERT INTO profiles (profile_hash, attrs)
SELECT sha256(profile_attrs::text), profile_attrs
FROM events
WHERE profile_attrs IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY profile_attrs
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

-- batch update top routes: update events e set profile_id = p.id, profile_attrs = NULL from profiles p where sha256(e.profile_attrs::text) = p.profile_hash and e.route_id = <route> limit 10000;

alex: Versioning envelope.schema = "analytics.v2" and fallback analytics.v1. Use feature flag ingest_compact to toggle writes.

priya: Canary plan?

maria: Canary ingest v2 at 10% with golden-query diffs (top-40 dashboards). Abort if diffs > 0.5% or profile-miss-rate > 3% sustained 30m. Track ingest 5xx, console p95/p99, profile-cache-hit.

dave: Ops: schedule backfill windows off-peak. Also check partition hotness after compaction.

ingest-bot: canary-deploy: ingest-service:v2 started on cluster-us-west-2 at 10% traffic.

simon: One more for label sets: convert ui_labels->labelset_id where label order is normalized. Build label_sets table and backfill deterministically.

priya: I'll own docs and the support playbook with common broken-query patterns and quick fixes.

maria: Timeline draft: day0 RFC, day2 canary 10%, day5 dual-write 100% (v1+v2), day8 targeted backfill for top routes, day12 console shim default to compact for non-legacy clients, week 4 review.

alex: I'll implement the console read-adapter shim and the compatibility endpoint.

dave: Infra ok; please file INFRA ticket for backfill capacity.

maria: Thanks. I'll open the RFC and tracking ticket. If anyone sees risks call them out now.

ingest-bot: canary-deploy: ingest-service:v2 canary increased to 30% on cluster-us-west-2.
